guide: IDS is the Isuzu Dealer Standard: an annual dealer evaluation. Each dealer scores a percentage of the points available. The national average is the average of that country's own dealers.

source.note: Coordinates were resolved by the IDS build and are reproduced here unchanged. Each dealer carries geo_label, which states how its position was derived.

deeper_view: The full radar and the per-question view live in the IDS dealer compare page: 02_dashboards/ids/IDS_2026_dealer_compare.html
